title: Declare external references and inspect every provider kind
task_type: Unity Editor asset and build verification
environment: One bounded Unity 2022.3.22f1 route. This does not prove arbitrary component fidelity, all avatars, or permission to redistribute external SDKs.
goal: Finalize exported content whose framework components remain external.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The exported dependency contract omitted script prerequisites, and the initial provider search covered C# metadata only.
what_worked: Historical correction: Declare selected-chain GUID/signed-localID references with revision-bound requiring contexts. Preflight public MonoScript resolution before mutation; explicitly refuse absent or malformed providers. Verification reported by the source: Retrying the same output with exact providers changed missing scripts from 55 to zero and passed first/repeated Apply. Ten public controls covered declarations, absent-provider refusal and same-output recovery.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: Output compiled, yet finalization refused 55 missing scripts; the dependency manifest was empty and an initial source-script search missed compiled providers.
why: Confirmed: required exact script references were undeclared; provider identity could reside in compiled script assets, not only source files.
improved_method: Separate preserved reference identity from provider availability. Search all relevant provider kinds and verify exact references before blaming unrelated geometry or bundling a framework.
when_to_use: One bounded Unity 2022.3.22f1 route. This does not prove arbitrary component fidelity, all avatars, or permission to redistribute external SDKs.
when_not_to_use: This does not prove arbitrary component fidelity, all avatars, or permission to redistribute external SDKs.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
